notes: This portable C++ TCK slice registers two objects, sends three timestamped Update Attribute Values invocations (two to one instance and one to another), advances a time-regulating subject and time-constrained target, verifies all timestamped Reflect Attribute Values callbacks and their delivery metadata, then has a distinct joined requester ask the standard MIM for the target's HLAreportObjectInstancesReflected count. The report must count two distinct instances in the adapter-supplied registered class. It uses only official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM names and data elements, the public object-class handle decoder, HLAbyte, HLAinteger32BE, HLAoctet, HLAfixedRecord, HLAvariableArray, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, MIM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It uses no private headers, provider registry, or vendor-specific names.
